KNOW #2 📚 Lot Size Samjho
Same trade, same pips, phir bhi kisi ko $10 milte hain aur kisi ko $1000. Kyun?
• Jawab hai lot size. Lot matlab aapki trade kitni badi hai.
• 1 standard lot = 1,00,000 units. EURUSD me 1 pip ≈ $10.
• Mini lot 0.10 = $1 per pip. Micro lot 0.01 = 10 cents.
Tip: pehle risk decide karo, phir lot nikalo. Ulta nahi.
